name: Apology Bow
description: Use when apologising sincerely or admitting a mistake ("I'm so sorry!"). Presses the palms together at the chest and bows quickly and deeply with eyes squeezed shut and a sorry face.

name: Arms Crossed
description: Use while skeptical, unconvinced or holding a firm stance; steady rather than sulky. Holds both arms crossed with a slight head tilt and a faintly stern look.

name: Cat Monster Rawr
description: Use when playfully pretending to be a monster: a mock roar, teasing or silly intimidation, not cute. Crouches with claws up by the face, roars wide-mouthed, then swipes the claws.

name: Cheeky Finger Guns
description: Use to punctuate a joke, a cheeky compliment or confident agreement. Aims finger guns with both hands, fires them and winks.

name: Double Peace Pop
description: Use to celebrate, greet with excitement or pose playfully, with more energy than a one-hand peace sign. Pops up peace signs with both hands, sways and winks with a big smile.

name: Double Thumbs Down
description: Use for strong or playfully exaggerated disapproval or rejection; stronger than one thumb. Drops both thumbs down, pushes them twice like a "boo" and pouts.

name: Double Thumbs Up
description: Use for enthusiastic approval, encouragement or celebrating someone's success; stronger than one thumb. Pops both thumbs up, pumps them twice and winks.

name: Explain with Open Palms
description: Use only when the reply walks through an explanation, steps or reasons ("let me explain", "here's why"); not for short answers, greetings or small talk. Raises both open palms in front and offers them outward in two small beats, with an attentive, slight smile.

name: Finger Heart Pose
description: Use for a sweet thank-you, appreciation or cute affection. Raises a finger heart beside the cheek with a wink while a little heart pops up above the fingers.

name: Goodbye Wave
description: Use when saying goodbye or ending a chat warmly. Raises the right arm high and waves broadly, then lays the hand on the heart with a small nod and a smile.

name: Hands on Hips
description: Use while feeling confident, determined or playfully impatient. Stands with both hands on the hips, shifting weight side to side with a smile.

name: Heart Hands
description: Use to send warm affection, gratitude or support. Brings both hands together into a heart shape with a big beaming smile.

name: Left OK Sign
description: Use while confirming that something is correct, ready or going well. Holds up a left-hand OK sign with a smile and a tilted head.

name: Left Peace Sign
description: Use while greeting casually, reassuring or posing in a relaxed, cheerful way. Pops up a left-hand peace sign and holds it with a wink.

name: Prayer Hands Thanks
description: Use when thanking the user warmly or showing happy gratitude for help, a gift or kind words. Presses the palms together at the chest and gives a small double nod with a closed-eye smile.

name: Right Face Palm
description: Use when reacting to an obvious mistake, an awkward moment or something exasperating, not for shyness. Covers the face with the right hand, eyes shut, with a small head shake.

name: Right Finger Point
description: Use to point at the user: a playful call-out, a "you!" or a pointed reminder. Jabs the right index finger forward three times with a smile.

name: Right Thumbs Down
description: Use while disapproving, disagreeing or showing disappointment. Holds a right thumbs down with a small "boo" push and a pout.

name: Right Thumbs Up
description: Use while approving, agreeing, encouraging or reassuring. Holds up a right thumbs up with a small pump and a smile.

name: Shy Finger Poke Loop
description: Use while feeling bashful, nervous or hesitant, such as making a shy request or confession. Bows the head and keeps tapping the index fingers together.

name: Hand on Heart
description: Use while speaking sincerely: heartfelt gratitude, empathy or a personal promise. Holds the right hand over the heart with a calm, gentle face.

name: Salute
description: Use when acknowledging a request, accepting a task or playfully reporting ready to help. Snaps a right-hand salute to the brow with a nod and a wink.

name: Tear Wipe
description: Use when feeling sad, hurt or moved to tears but trying to stay brave, such as after bad news, a goodbye or a touching moment. Lowers the head, wipes under the right eye twice with a curled knuckle and a sniffle, then looks up with a small brave smile.

name: Thinking Hand on Chin
description: Use while openly pausing to think before answering ("hmm, let me think…"); not for ordinary answers or explanations, and lighter than a deep ponder. Thumb under the jaw and index along the cheek, glancing up as the finger taps.

name: Thinking Head Scratch
description: Use while puzzled or trying to work something out; thinking, not sheepish. Keeps a hand on the head, scratching now and then, with a tilted head and an upward glance.
